svg.title: Wildbound — desktop encounter
svg.desc: 1440 × 900 desktop HUD. First-friend tutorial state: free berry offered, sneak held, protected Mossbun catch. Currency, weather, objective, icon rail and encounter controls use live game text and geometry. Editable vector design reference for the native Roblox implementation. This is not a Studio screenshot or a file created with Figma.
